sentences.text: Ichthyovenator is a genus of dinosaur belonging to the family Spinosauridae and the subfamily Spinosaurinae.
Its straight, conical teeth suggest a diet focused on catching aquatic animals.
The skeleton featured a reduced pelvic girdle where the ilium was proportionately longer than the pubis and ischium.
Fossils were first found in 2010 at Ban Kalum within the Savannakhet Basin in Laos.
Palaeontologist Ronan Allain and colleagues formally described the species in 2012.
Evidence from limb bone density and oxygen isotope ratios indicates a semiaquatic lifestyle.
While the jaw shape points to a fish-eating habit, some relatives may have eaten larger prey.
Although no limb bones are known, related spinosaurids possessed enlarged thumb claws for hunting.
This animal lived between 120 and 113 million years ago in what is now Asia.
Scientists debate whether the dorsal sail served for sexual display or species recognition.
In 2014, Allain placed it in Spinosaurinae based on teeth and vertebrae, but a 2015 study suggested traits of both subfamilies exist.
